business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Distribution of Clinical Diagnostic ELISA Assays and Reagents

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Civil Law with Islamic Sharia as a principal source of legislation per Constitution of 2014, Art. 2)

Egypt-United States Treaty Concerning the Reciprocal Encouragement and Protection of Investments (1986, in force 1992)

Egypt-Saudi Arabia Bilateral Investment Treaty and bilateral double taxation arrangement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Egyptian AML/CFT framework comprises Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (as subsequently amended), Prime Ministerial Decree No. 404 of 2003 issuing its Executive Regulations (as amended), Law No. 94 of 2015 on Combating Terrorism, Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 and Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 imposing beneficial ownership register and disclosure duties, together with EMLCU (Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit) and Central Bank of Egypt rulemaking aligned to FATF and MENAFATF standards.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each shareholder and each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Egypt is a Contracting State) OR Consular Legalization at the Egyptian embassy/consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming source of funds for each shareholder or UBO
Certificate of Incumbency / Certificate of Good Standing for any corporate shareholder
Board resolution authorizing the Egyptian LLC incorporation and naming the local agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the corporate shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney in favor of the Egyptian incorporation agent
Certified Arabic translation of all foreign-issued documents above
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Sworn translator accredited by the Egyptian Ministry of Justice
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No apostille required; translator seal certified by the Ministry of Justice translation office

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory customer due diligence under Law No. 80 of 2002: verify identity and beneficial ownership of all shareholders, directors, and authorized signatories; screen against OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated Lists, EU and UK HMT sanctions lists, Egypt EMLCU/CBE counter-terrorism designation lists, and Egyptian court asset-freeze lists under Law No. 94 of 2015; enhanced due diligence (PEP-EDD) is required for foreign and domestic politically exposed persons, including source-of-wealth verification and senior management approval before onboarding any high-risk PEP relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI IADA electronic establishment portal (www.gafi.gov.eg) interfacing with the Ministry of Trade and Industry Commercial Registry (Tijara)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The LLC legal name must be stated in Arabic and the Arabic form is authoritative; a Latin transliteration may be registered as a parallel foreign name upon declaration of correspondence at incorporation. Foreign-only names are not permissible for a domestic Egyptian LLC. Any subsequent divergence between the Arabic and transliterated Latin names requires rectification filing with the Commercial Registry.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Finance, Financial, Insurance, Securities, Stock Exchange (require prior CBE or Financial Regulatory Authority approval)
Arab Republic, Government, National, Public, State, Military, Police
Islamic, Sharia (when used to denote financial services; requires CBE authorization and Sharia supervisory board confirmation)
Pharmaceutical, Medical, Diagnostic, Laboratory, Biological, Blood, Reagent (require Egyptian Drug Authority no-objection before GAFI clearance)
Names identical or confusingly similar to an existing name in the Commercial Registry name pool
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The 30-day reservation may be renewed once for an additional 30 days through the IADA portal for a further statutory fee. If the name is rejected, the applicant receives an Arabic-language rejection notice from the GAFI name committee; an administrative grievance may be filed within 15 working days accompanied by two alternative name proposals, and the committee must issue a written decision within 10 working days. If the rejection is upheld, the applicant may refile under new proposed names after a 7-day cooldown or challenge the decision before the Administrative Judicial Court (State Council) within 60 days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as a standalone registered address. GAFI and the Commercial Registry require a physical leased or owned premises in Egypt; serviced offices are acceptable only if a dedicated desk or office, building signage, and a serviced-office provider commitment to accept official service of process are documented. A PO Box is insufficient. For IVD reagent wholesale distribution, the Egyptian Drug Authority will require an operational and addressable premise for license endorsement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: 8-12% probability of an unannounced inspection within the first 12 months and 15-20% within 36 months, reflecting the licensed-trade nature of clinical diagnostic reagent distribution and EDA inspection mandates; on-site presence and physical corporate records are mandatory.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended by Law No. 4 of 2009 and Law No. 148 of 2023 (Articles 1-25 on incorporation of limited liability companies), read together with Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its executive regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Companies Registration Directorate and One-Stop Shop (OSS), Cairo.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Ta'sis) and Memorandum of Association filed through the GAFI e-incorporation platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital after the 2023 amendments; however, at least 25% of the subscribed nominal share capital must be fully paid at formation and deposited in a dedicated bank subscription account, with the bank certificate of deposit held in escrow until the commercial registry certificate is issued.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Articles of Association of EG_LLC be ratified and that the founders' declaration of share subscription be approved and recorded in the statutory share register. RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company be established at its principal place of business in Cairo, Egypt, and that all statutory notices be addressed there. RESOLVED that [Name] be appointed Managing Director, [Name] Head of Finance and Administration, and [Name] Compliance Officer, each vested with authority to execute filings, open bank accounts, and represent the Company before GAFI, the Egyptian Drug Authority, and all licensing authorities. RESOLVED that the Company proceed with all formation, industrial licensing, and environmental registration applications.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Legal Form Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI - One-Stop Shop e-Services Portal and Commercial Registry Name Search Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three consecutive Arabic corporate name candidates through the GAFI electronic platform, specifying the LLC legal form and the stated IVD wholesale distribution activity. The name must not contradict public order, carrying the indicator 'Limited Liability Company' or its abbreviation. The GAFI system runs a commercial registry conflict check against existing trademarks and registered company names.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of all founding shareholders
Signed name reservation application
Proposed Articles of Association draft
Power of attorney for local agent if incorporation is executed by proxy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, refile with the second and third alternative candidates; correct Arabic transliteration issues in writing and resubmit within 30 days before the application lapses.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Articles of Association and Share Subscription Clauses
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Justice - Public Notary Office (Notarization of Companies' Contracts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the finalized Articles of Association containing the shareholders' subscription schedule, capital apportionment, management clauses, and designated legal representation. The notary verifies the identity of the signatories and the statutory legality of the clauses, then authenticates the contract stamps and certifies certified Arabic copies. The notarized copy is the controlling instrument for the GAFI submission.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate from GAFI
Passports with valid residence status of each shareholder
Draft Articles of Association in Arabic
Shareholders' signatures page and witness declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary issues a memorandum of correction, amend the offending clauses and schedule a re-notarization appointment; rejected contracts may be replaced with a revised consolidated version without losing the name reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Submission and Commercial Registry Entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI - Companies Registration Directorate and Unified Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete incorporation application on the GAFI one-stop-shop platform, attaching the notarized Articles of Association, bank capital deposit certificate, proof of registered office address, and the managers' consent declarations. Upon validation, pay the statutory fees and receive the certificate of incorporation and the commercial registration extract constituting legal personality.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association (certified Arabic copy)
Bank certificate of the 25% paid-up capital deposit in the subscription account
Registered office lease contract or title deed with notarized address declaration
Manager and director acceptance letters
GAFI statutory form signed by all founders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Submit missing documents through the OSS portal within the statutory 30-day cure period; respond to the GAFI technical objections via an official memorandum with certified corrective documents to prevent application cancellation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Statistical Registry and Social Insurance Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS), and National Organization for Social Insurance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the newly incorporated LLC with the ETA to obtain a tax card (Commercial Tax File) and VAT certificate, complete the CAPMAS statistical registration, and enroll the company and its eligible officers in the social insurance system. The tax card must state the IVD wholesale activity code for medical supplies trading.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation and commercial register extract
GAFI notified registered office contract
Founders' and managers' national IDs or passports
Bank account statement and capital deposit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify data mismatches between the commercial register and tax application; file a reassessment request with the ETA registry manager and provide amended notarized address confirmation if the tax file is placed under review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Pre-Licensing Appointment of Qualified Person and Facility Dossier
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Drug Authority (EDA) - Central Administration for Medical Devices
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the pre-licensing application for the wholesale distribution of in-vitro diagnostic reagents, including the nomination of a qualified scientific officer, the cold-chain storage facility lease, and the quality management system summary. This step initiates the EDA inspection queue and confirms the legal suitability of the company for the special licensing regime applicable to IVD products.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation and ETA tax card
Qualified person (pharmacist or biomedical scientist) credential dossier
Cold storage warehouse lease and temperature mapping schedule
Proposed standard operating procedures for IVD handling and traceability
Environmental facility description form for storage operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the EDA deficiency letter within 15 working days; schedule a supplementary inspection and submit corrective infrastructure proofs (refrigeration validation, security, spill containment) to restore the licensing timeline.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Egyptian Drug Authority (EDA) - Central Administration for Medical Devices and Subsidiary Licensing Directorate
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Wholesale Distribution License for In-Vitro Diagnostic Reagents and Medical Devices (Good Storage Practice Authorization)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment - Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - Simplified Environmental Registration (Form B Environmental Dossier) applicable to wholesale warehousing and low-risk reagent distribution operations without manufacturing lines
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Environment Law No. 4 of 1994 and its Executive Regulations; wastewater discharge to public sewer per Ministerial Decree No. 44 of 2000 with pH 6-9.5, BOD not exceeding 350 mg/L, COD not exceeding 700 mg/L and TSS not exceeding 500 mg/L; fugitive VOC emissions from reagent storage controlled below EEAA workplace thresholds; hazardous and expired reagent waste managed under a formal tracking manifest with licensed waste transporters.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by the Civil Defense Directorate of the Ministry of Interior after inspection of the cold-chain storage units, alarm systems and emergency evacuation plan; structural load inspection certificate for the warehousing facility; and occupational safety clearance from the Ministry of Manpower covering chemical spill containment, personal protective equipment, and training records for handling diagnostic reagents.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – official portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; electronic tax filing and registration services accessible via the ETA e-services portal and the unified Egypt Tax Platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities establishing an Egyptian LLC must first complete commercial registration at the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) or the Ministry of Trade and Industry; thereafter, the LLC must apply to the Egyptian Tax Authority for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) by submitting the certificate of incorporation, commercial register extract, power of attorney for the legal representative, audited opening balance sheet where required, lease or ownership proof of premises, and valid national ID/passport copies of directors; the ETA issues a unified tax card that consolidates income tax, VAT, payroll tax, and stamp tax registration; a separate VAT registration certificate is issued where taxable turnover exceeds the mandatory registration threshold; foreign shareholders may also be required to provide a tax domicile certificate and beneficial ownership declaration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egyptian tax law does not provide a general check-the-box pass-through election for LLCs; the LLC is by default subject to entity-level corporate income tax under Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005; no hybrid mismatch elections are available in the domestic regime; however, certain investment structures within the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) may elect to be treated as free-zone entities exempt from income tax and VAT for activities within the zone, with the election made at the time of the investment incorporation dossier; for international groups, transfer pricing documentation may include elective application of the OECD standard but no entity classification election akin to US Subchapter K is recognized.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable supplies threshold for mandatory VAT registration; service providers may also be subject to the reverse-charge mechanism regardless of local turnover; no sales and use tax applies at the national level.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt has phased in an e-invoicing system operated by the ETA; taxpayers subject to VAT above an annual turnover threshold (currently EGP 50 million, with phased adoption for lower thresholds) must transmit all tax invoices through the ETA's electronic invoice platform using REST APIs with Swagger-documented integration; each invoice receives a QR-coded unique ID and cryptographic hash from the ETA central clearance server in near-real time; e-receipts are also mandatory for business-to-consumer sales under the phased rollout; digital stamping is embedded in the invoice UUID and hash; penalties apply for failure to integrate, late submission, or generating invoices outside the approved clearance channel.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to exported goods where title passes to a non-resident purchaser and the goods are physically removed from Egypt within a defined time window; exports must be supported by a signed export declaration and customs release; services listed as export services in the VAT implementing regulations (including services supplied and wholly consumed outside Egypt and offshore services related to exported goods) may also be zero-rated; documentary requirements include binding sales contracts, presentation of bank transfer / irrevocable letter of credit evidencing payment from a non-resident account, and proof of shipment; there is no domestic zero-rating for medical reagents sold to Egyptian hospitals unless explicitly listed in Annex provisions; diagnostic reagent supplies to government research institutions may be subject to 0% or withholding treatment only if a separate treaty or ministerial decree applies.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CargoX / ACI-pre-registered export declaration)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT credit proof evidencing forex repatriation
Goods inspection certificate if applicable to IVD biological reagents
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA may perform post-export audits within five years and may disallow zero-rating where the foreign exchange has not been repatriated within the 180-day deadline, where export documentation is incomplete, or where the transaction is found to be artificial or sham; penalties range from 100% of the VAT amount due plus a late-payment surcharge of 2% per month (capped at 100% of the tax), criminal fines under the VAT Law for fraudulent invoices, and imprisonment for tax evasion; the ETA also routinely cross-references customs export declarations with banking transfer data through the unified platform; if the export is subsequently cancelled or the goods are reimported without valid cause, the output VAT is clawed back retrospectively with statutory interest.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt operates a managed-float exchange rate regime. As of current practice, the EGP is convertible for current-account transactions (trade in goods and services, remittances, dividends) under CBE licensing. Capital-account transactions (direct equity injection, shareholder loans, exit proceeds) remain subject to case-by-case CBE approval and must be registered with the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) to secure future profit repatriation. Repatriation of profits and capital requires an audited financial statement, tax clearance, and confirmation that all statutory banking obligations (e.g., export proceeds rule) are satisfied. Practical delays may occur during FX liquidity stress; companies should pre-arrange clearing with an authorized bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: All export proceeds from Egyptian entities must be repatriated through an authorized bank within 120 days of the bill-of-lading or air-way-bill date. Proceeds must be credited to the exporter's foreign-currency account held in Egypt, and the CBE requires mandatory conversion of the full amount to EGP upon receipt (unless the exporter holds a valid foreign-currency retention license granted under CBE regulations). For a diagnostic reagent distributor, import operations must demonstrate that export proceeds used for trade settlement are routed through the same banking channel to avoid penalty.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (EGP) and FX Savings Account
Capital Escrow Account for Initial EC Injection
Operational Account with Trade Finance & LC desk

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Offshore digital EMI platforms (e.g., Wise, Payoneer, Revolut Business) are not licensed by CBE and cannot hold EGP accounts or execute local/domestic payouts. Their utility is limited to non-Egyptian treasury side transactions (e.g., receiving funds in USD/EUR from vendors outside Egypt), but all settlements to or from Egypt must pass through a CBE-licensed bank. Legal constraints include foreign exchange control regulations and AML/CFT Law No. 80 of 2002, which prohibit local businesses from maintaining operational bank balances with unlicensed foreign virtual account providers.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: CBE sanctions require an in-person interview at the bank's branch for all authorized signatories and at least one board director of the LLC. Remote onboarding is conditionally permitted for foreign shareholders under a power-of-attorney executed before an Egyptian consulate, but the authorized agent must attend in person with original passport and corporate documents. For a 100% foreign-owned diagnostic reagent distributor, CBE and bank compliance desks typically demand a local resident manager or approved attorney with a notarized authorization deed.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Change of shareholder structure within 6 months of account opening
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation, share purchase agreements, board resolution approving new shareholding list, GAFI notification, passport copies of all shareholders, and proof of source of funds for share consideration (bank statements or SWIFT advice).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume trade with tax-haven jurisdiction counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of tax residency (COR), tax invoice showing arm's length pricing, purchase order, bill of lading, customs import declaration, banking reference letter from the counterparty's bank, and distribution agreement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient business substance for a distribution entity (thin capitalization)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Physical office lease, annual business plan with healthcare market evidence, license from Egyptian Ministry of Health (registration of medical devices), insurance coverage, and operational expenditure invoices (payroll, rent, utilities).

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound foreign capital for the LLC must be routed via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 from the overseas investor to a CBE-licensed bank, with payment narrative citing 'CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION' or 'EQUITY CONTRIBUTION' and referencing the GAFI registration number. The bank will complete CBE Form 20 (statement of capital movement) and issuance of an import exemption certificate if the capital will be utilized for goods. All inbound transfers require pre-clearance with the bank's treasury desk; funds cannot be released to the operational account until a CBE compliance approval and GAFI capital verification are completed. Transfer fees typically range USD 10-50 for incoming wire plus 0.2% CBE charge.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For import of laboratory diagnostic reagents, clearing must be executed via SWIFT MT103 (TT payment) or an Irrevocable Documentary Letter of Credit (LC) opened through a commercial bank in Egypt. MT103 payments should specify the Customs HS Code and import declaration number to avoid document mismatch. LC issuance requires a 100% cash margin for a newly formed LLC or a stand-by letter of credit guarantee. The supplier's bill will be paid only after the presenting bank submits compliant documents (bill of lading, certificate of origin, insurance, commercial invoice) to the CBE-based receiving bank. Alternative clearing rail: Payment in Installments through approved factoring/confirming houses using the 'Banker's Acceptance' instrument is permitted but carries additional interest. Direct local currency settlement from customer receivables must be converted to USD/EUR at the prevailing interbank rate to fund the trade payment.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forwards (deliverable) contracts up to 12 months settled against CBE midpoint rate
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) referencing official EGP/USD rate for hedging EGP cash flows with non-resident banks
Currency Swaps (cross-currency interest rate swaps) approved by CBE Treasury Department for matching import liabilities
Commodity-Linked Hedges using OTC structured forwards allowed for inventory procurement
Import LC with FX hedge rider (roll-over forward) provided by licensed Egyptian banks

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements and corporate report to the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Companies Registration and Financial Statements Submission Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months following the fiscal year-end; for calendar year-end companies, no later than 30 June, with shareholders' approval preceding the filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine not exceeding EGP 50,000 under Companies Law No. 159/1981; repeated default can lead to suspension of corporate status by GAFI and eventual administrative strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return (Form No. 21) accompanied by audited financial statements and required supporting schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – Income Tax Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the end of the corporate tax year; for a 31 December tax year, due no later than 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment fine equal to 2% of the unpaid tax for each month or part of a month of delay, capped at 25% of the tax due; sustained non-filing may trigger tax liens and criminal prosecution under Law No. 91/2005.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – commercial tax office with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 January; the tax card remains valid for one calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Renewal becomes impossible after the administrative deadline without a fine of approximately EGP 500; an expired tax card blocks customs clearance, public tender participation, and certain government transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Register renewal declaration and fee payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registrar (Ministry of Trade and Industry) through the GAFI one-stop-shop
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By the anniversary of the initial commercial registration each year; for December registrations, no later than 31 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal surcharge of approximately EGP 2,500 applies; continued default permits removal of the commercial register entry and loss of the LLC's legal capacity to trade, followed by strike-off proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Egyptian LLCs must appoint at least one certified auditor under Companies Law No. 159/1981. A micro-enterprise exemption is available only if the company obtains a micro-enterprise certificate under Law No. 141/2018, generally requiring assets and turnover below EGP 1,000,000 and fewer than 10 employees; without such certificate, an independent audited financial statement is compulsory.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), which substantially converge with IFRS; EAS are mandatory for Egyptian legal entities, while IFRS is acceptable for consolidated reporting or branches of foreign entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Egyptian law does not impose a separate annual UBO return. The LLC must maintain a register of partners, record every share transfer, and disclose beneficial ownership information to the Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) under the anti-money-laundering framework. Any shareholding transfer must be reported to GAFI outside the annual cycle; the manager must keep the ultimate beneficial owner information current and available for official inspection.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory CIT holiday for pure IVD reagent wholesale distribution. Investment Law No. 72/2017 allows a preferential deduction of up to 50% of invested capital for qualifying projects satisfying employment, export, or regional-development criteria; a plain trading LLC is rarely eligible. SCZone entities may obtain customs and regulatory waivers, but CIT remains 22.5%. Outbound dividends bear a final 10% withholding tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 19 (Corporate Income Tax Return) filed electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-filing portal at www.eta.gov.eg
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months from the close of the tax year (e.g., 30 April for a 31 December fiscal year-end)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, 9-digit Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN), trade register number, import code, address, and contact data of the Egyptian LLC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the resident LLC's TIN only; never substitute the foreign parent company's TIN. A non-resident with Egyptian-source income files separately through a designated tax representative.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year-end date, currency, and accounting standard applied.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare the audited fiscal year-end. All transfer pricing documentation must be aligned to the same 12-month reporting period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross proceeds from wholesale sales of clinical diagnostic ELISA assays and reagents, including Egyptian domestic sales and any export revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report in EGP and reconcile with e-invoice/e-receipt records transmitted to the ETA. Foreign-currency sales must be translated using Central Bank of Egypt rates applicable on transaction dates.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Duty-paid cost of imported and locally sourced reagents, assay kits, consumables, and inventory adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany purchases from the offshore group must be arm's length and supported by customs release documents and the Local File when the EGP 10 million controlled-transaction threshold is met.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Salaries, warehouse rent, logistics, distribution fees, depreciation, insurance, and financing costs attributable to the Egyptian wholesale activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to non-residents is capped by the 30% EBITDA limitation. Royalties or management fees to the foreign parent are deductible only when the economic benefit to the Egyptian entity is proven and withholding tax has been applied.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line C1 - Taxable Income / Adjusted Loss
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of adjusted taxable profit after statutory disallowances and loss carry-forwards (maximum 5 years).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile the audited financial statements with the tax computation. Loss carry-forward claims require documented prior-year returns and cannot be used to offset outbound dividend distributions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line C2 - Tax at Statutory Rate
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT computed at 22.5%, reduced by advance payments, PAYE credits, and withholding credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No franking credit or foreign tax credit is available for taxes paid by the foreign parent. Advance CIT instalments previously remitted must be reconciled to the final liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Summary of controlled transactions with related parties (value, method, tested party, and benchmark margin).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory where aggregate controlled transactions exceed EGP 10 million per tax year. Documentation must be prepared in Arabic or English; use CUP or TNMM benchmarks sourced from the Egyptian or MENA market.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a fixed fine of EGP 10,000 to EGP 50,000 plus an additive tax of 2% of the unpaid CIT per month of delay. Incorrect or fraudulent returns attract an additional fine of up to 100% of the tax difference. Failure to attach TP forms separately attracts EGP 50,000 to EGP 500,000 per violation and automatically triggers an ETA TP audit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: TP Documentation Annex - Local File and Master File declaration submitted as an annex to Form 19 via the ETA e-file system; CbC Report filed through the ETA data-exchange portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Same deadline as the annual CIT return (within 4 months after fiscal year-end); underlying TP documentation must be produced within 30 days of an ETA request

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List of related-party purchases and services, including imported ELISA kits from the Chinese manufacturer, with value, currency, and contract reference numbers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State amounts in EGP using Central Bank of Egypt exchange rates for the tax year; include customs-cleared CIF values and any offshore service fees.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selected OECD method (CUP, resale price, cost plus, TNMM, or profit split), tested party, and functional analysis summary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Egyptian distributor should normally be the tested party where it performs routine logistics and local marketing without ownership of unique intangibles.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Comparable operating margin range, database used, year of data, and supporting financial extracts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Benchmark data must be updated annually; foreign comparables are accepted only where Egyptian market data is unavailable. Retention of source documents is mandatory for five years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-submission of the TP annex: EGP 50,000 to EGP 500,000 per violation. Incomplete documentation permits the ETA to presume a non-arm's length price, reassess taxable income, and apply the 2% monthly additive tax on the underpaid CIT.
